design: Each write performs one explicit domain operation. Clients compose summaries and multi-step workflows through repeated primitive calls. Browser/HTTP Actions retain their contracts.

tools.name: context_get
tools.purpose: Space, generation, scene support and supported workflow actions

tools.name: tasks_query
tools.purpose: Open/done tasks, kind/date/query filters and pagination

tools.name: records_query
tools.purpose: Approval/travel/expense lists or one detail with its history and input reference options

tools.name: approval_submit
tools.purpose: Submit or resubmit one approval request

tools.name: expense_prepare
tools.purpose: Validate and save one new or returned expense claim, without submitting it

tools.name: workflow_transition
tools.purpose: Perform one explicitly named transition using existing domain services

tools.name: analysis_query
tools.purpose: Query live business or historical analysis

composition.dailySummary: Call tasks_query with from/to equal to the desired date, separately for open and done tasks; paginate and calculate counts/overdue from the results.
composition.expenseWorkflow: records_query -> receipt_register as needed -> expense_prepare -> workflow_transition(submit) -> workflow_transition(approve or return); after return repeat expense_prepare and submit.
composition.completeTodo: Use tasks_query to obtain sourceType/sourceId/sourceVersion, then call workflow_transition for that source. No duplicate todo completion tool.
